scope: Bounded discovery of Icelandic EEA/EFTA free-movement and third-country family-member sources, legislation and publication, residence registration, visa/entry channels, administrative procedure and remedies, appeal decisions, courts, public access, privacy and oversight. Iceland is an EEA EFTA State, not an EU Member State. Switzerland is not an EEA Contracting Party. This is not a legal-equivalence opinion or complete national inventory.
retrieval_status: 20 of 28 candidate pages converted and replay-verified; 21 exact responses saved; six Althingi HTTP 403 responses; one court-page 404; one captured page had no extractable body; no source accepted

comparison_seed.source: Danish EU-residence law and official guidance used as the comparison seed
comparison_seed.relationship_note: Iceland has a functionally related national route for EEA/EFTA citizens and their family members. Iceland's distinct EEA EFTA status, EEA incorporation, national implementation, Swiss treatment, Nordic arrangements, and Icelandic return-citizen route must be checked separately. Similar function does not establish legal equivalence.

previous_findings_carried_forward: The Denmark, Sweden, Czechia, Hungary, Romania, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, and Greece findings were used as discovery and adapter-design leads only; none establishes Icelandic law or source coverage.
The cross-state discovery guide excludes N-Lex as an assumed source for Iceland because Iceland is an EEA EFTA State; first-party Icelandic and EFTA sources were used.

The EFTA EEA-Lex record confirms Directive 2004/38/EC was incorporated by Joint Committee Decision 158/2007 and is in force in the EEA; Icelandic national scope and procedure still require checking against Icelandic law.

search_coverage.source_class: Legislation, official publication, consolidated text and EEA incorporation
search_coverage.search_outcome: Candidates found; the current Althingi legislation bundle is well-documented, while consolidation date and legal effect must be distinguished from later enactments and future effective dates.
official_channels: Althingi Lagasafn current index and versioned SGML/PDF editions
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Althingi's current edition is dated 1 October 2026 and the archive says later-passed laws are absent from each edition. The current Foreign Nationals Act page lists amendments with different effective dates, including future changes. Reglugerðasafn lists several 2026 amendments to Regulation 540/2017, while its linked current-consolidation PDF identifies a version in force from 19 June 2025; amendment reconciliation is unresolved. No Icelandic substantive law is inferred from the Danish seed.

search_coverage.coverage_limit: The EEA/EFTA label on Ísland.is includes Switzerland in its country lists even though Switzerland is not in the EEA Agreement. Icelandic citizens are treated separately and may use an EEA return route only under stated prior-residence conditions. Registers Iceland's page title/form describes registration exceeding six months while its body says EEA/EFTA nationals staying over three months must register; the Directorate entry page says over six months. These conflicts need legal-owner review.

Search results identify EEA/EFTA decisions, but no complete case inventory or stable machine-readable feed was verified.
